name: ServiceNow
description: Connect your own ServiceNow instance (OAuth2 or Basic Auth) to manage Incidents, Problems, Change Requests, Service Catalog Requests, Knowledge Articles, and CMDB CIs through the Now Platform Table API, plus a generic table passthrough for anything else your instance exposes.

tools.name: connect_servicenow
tools.description: Connect a ServiceNow instance via OAuth2 or Basic Auth, after validating connectivity.

username.description: Integration user username (required for Basic Auth).
username.title: Username

password.description: Integration user password (required for Basic Auth).
password.title: Password

client_id.description: OAuth2 Application Registry client ID (required for OAuth2).
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: OAuth2 Application Registry client secret (required for OAuth2).
client_secret.title: Client Secret

tools.name: disconnect_servicenow
tools.description: Disconnect a ServiceNow instance: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in ServiceNow itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved ServiceNow instance connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected ServiceNow instances.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents in the connected ServiceNow instance, optionally filtered by state/priority/assignee.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

state.description: Optional incident state filter, e.g. '1' (New), '2' (In Progress), '6' (Resolved), '7' (Closed).
state.title: State

assigned_to.description: Optional sys_id of the assigned user to filter by.
assigned_to.title: Assigned To

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Read one incident in full by sys_id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

caller_id.description: sys_id of the caller/requester, if known.
caller_id.title: Caller Id

tools.name: update_incident
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing incident (state, priority, assignment, notes). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

work_notes.description: Work note to append (internal, not customer-visible).
work_notes.title: Work Notes

close_notes.description: Close notes (required by ServiceNow when resolving/closing).
close_notes.title: Close Notes

tools.name: list_problems
tools.description: List problems in the connected ServiceNow instance, optionally filtered by state.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_problem
tools.description: Create a new problem record.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_problem
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing problem. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

work_notes.description: Work note to append (internal, not customer-visible).
work_notes.title: Work Notes

tools.name: list_change_requests
tools.description: List change requests in the connected ServiceNow instance, optionally filtered by state.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_change_request
tools.description: Create a new change request.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_change_request
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing change request (state, approval). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

work_notes.description: Work note to append (internal, not customer-visible).
work_notes.title: Work Notes

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List Service Catalog requests in the connected ServiceNow instance, optionally filtered by state.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Create a new Service Catalog request.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_request
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Service Catalog request. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

work_notes.description: Work note to append (internal, not customer-visible).
work_notes.title: Work Notes

tools.name: list_knowledge_articles
tools.description: List Knowledge articles in the connected ServiceNow instance.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_cmdb_cis
tools.description: List Configuration Items (CIs) in the CMDB, optionally filtered by class.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

ci_class.description: Optional CI class table name, e.g. 'cmdb_ci_server'. Defaults to base 'cmdb_ci'.
ci_class.title: Ci Class

tools.name: list_table
tools.description: List records from any ServiceNow table by name -- a generic passthrough for tables not covered by typed wrappers (e.g. custom tables).

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

fields.description: Optional comma-separated field list to limit the response.
fields.title: Fields

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Read one record from any ServiceNow table by sys_id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Create a new record on any ServiceNow table -- a generic passthrough for tables not covered by typed wrappers.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

fields.description: Field name/value pairs to set on the new record.
fields.title: Fields

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing record on any ServiceNow table. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Permanently delete a record from any ServiceNow table by sys_id. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_instance_health
tools.description: Build one aggregated health snapshot for the connected ServiceNow instance: open incidents, critical incidents, open problems, pending changes, open requests.

connection_id.description: Optional saved ServiceNow instance connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: servicenow_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected ServiceNow instances and encrypted credentials. Managed only through connect_servicenow and disconnect_servicenow.
